Same work, three views

Tree, board, and graph do not make copies. Change the projection and watch the same task entities move—their identity, work state, assignees, and relationships stay put.

01Change the projection

Release lane workflow · four tasks · one shared graph

Tree groups three child tasks beneath their parent. The lines come from parentId.

Four task buttons remain the same in every view. Ship invite flow is the parent. QA invite email, write migration notes, and retire token sign-in are its children. Write migration notes depends on QA invite email. Each button exposes the task id, status, category, and assignees.
